newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan brokerages slide on news of Nomura.
newsitem.headline: Japan brokerages slide on news of Nomura.

text.p: Shares in securities houses slid on Thursday, as worries about the sector grew on news that Tokyo prosecutors were raiding Nomura Securities Co Ltd's headquarters as part of an investigation into suspected illegal payoffs, traders said.
Brokerages topped the list of percentage losers on the Tokyo bourse's first section at 0401 GMT.
As of 0406 GMT, Nomura shares had lost 80 yen to trade at 1,400. Its turnover of 6.647 million shares made it the most actively traded issue.

Shares in Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd were down 23 yen to 327, making it the second largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo bourse. Its volume of 4.830 million shares was the third heaviest.
Shares in Nikko Securities Co Ltd were down 27 yen at 723, and those in Daiwa Securities Co Ltd down 22 yen at 860.
